newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady at $108/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady at $108/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were mostly steady with Tuesday on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said
Dressed Basis Steers: Select and Choice, and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 107.00-108.00, few 108.50; Mostly Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs 105.00-107.00.
Dressed Basis Heifers: Select and Choice, and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 107.00-108.00; Mostly Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 105.00-107.00.
Slaughter steers and heifers not established on a live basis. Buyer inquiry was uneven. Seller interest limited.
